audit_events_attributed_check.name: audit_events_attributed_check
audit_events_attributed_check.value:
"audit_events"."action" like '%.login'
          or ("audit_events"."operator_id" is not null and "audit_events"."upload_device_id" is not null)

episode_reviews_decided_check.name: episode_reviews_decided_check
episode_reviews_decided_check.value: "episode_reviews"."review_state" = 'pending' or ("episode_reviews"."reviewed_at" is not null and "episode_reviews"."effective_duration_s" is not null)

episodes_resolution_check.name: episodes_resolution_check
episodes_resolution_check.value:
("episodes"."resolution_state" = 'resolved' and "episodes"."collection_session_id" is not null)
          or ("episodes"."resolution_state" = 'quarantined' and "episodes"."collection_session_id" is null)

upload_batches_cache_after_verify_check.name: upload_batches_cache_after_verify_check
upload_batches_cache_after_verify_check.value: "upload_batches"."local_cache_cleaned_at" is null or ("upload_batches"."cloud_verified_at" is not null and "upload_batches"."local_cache_cleaned_at" >= "upload_batches"."cloud_verified_at")
